body:
Terrain gameplay currently infers movement, growth, placement and other capabilities from material names and sprite ranges. This change gives each stable terrain enum value compile-time gameplay properties and separate presentation metadata, then makes engine and AI decisions consume those capabilities. Ice and road exercise the architecture with separate, off-by-default authoring experiments; maps carry required experiments into matches and saves.

- Canonical terrain IDs are independent of graphics. Weighted ground/air movement, gradients, health, projectile obstruction, resource habitats, growth and signed fertility use indexed properties with neutral-terrain fast paths and cached fields.
- AI geospatial, placement and tactical queries, generators, editor, map images/reports, previews, minimap and overview rendering use the new model. JavaScript exposes immutable `ctx.game.terrainTypes()` and remembered `tile.terrainType`.
- Save format 134 retains legacy loading back to floor 58; replay floor 134, network protocol 55 and simulation revision 14 separate changed simulation behavior. Current golden traces and old-save continuation fixtures are included.

Independent implementation/review passes covered core persistence and experiments, movement/SIMD, AI/ecology/JavaScript, generators, and rendering/editor. Final Linux checks passed 792 headless unit cases and 290 focused groups (425 individual cases), plus external serial/parallel save/replay continuation, image/report tools, software/OpenGL rendering and independent sanitizer/scalar/ARM64-NEON kernel oracles. Full-game cross-platform comparisons remain unverified.

Performance and game feel require explicit qualification. Across six scenarios with seven alternating baseline/candidate pairs each, median normalized CPU/tick improved 8.80%, but one growth-enabled scenario regressed 18.89%; AI/RNG trajectories and work differ. Generic weighted paths and large ecology rebuilds cost more (dense 512² combined rebuild about 348 ms). A late optimization that regressed neutral workloads was rejected.

Isolated ecology training/holdout gates passed for adequately sampled cases; sparse resource cases remain inconclusive. In 96 paired AI games, a common midgame cohort showed more starvation. Targeted saved-state investigation found existing feeding-capacity/placement traps and swarms on an island without inns, with no verified terrain-permission or routing defect. This warning remains relevant to human playtesting and balance review; no coefficient or AI-policy tuning was used to hide it.

Local validation evidence, exact commands, hashes, checksums, saves, replays, screenshots and limitations are linked in the verification comment. The maintainer explicitly approved merging after these limitations were reported.

Local / VM verification

- **Tested commit:** `1abebe9e6d8d1a805319302edbc27fd291ad1ec8`. Committed after tests; all tracked-source, new-file and executable hashes were confirmed unchanged from the validation provenance.
- **Base/integration:** `934c3c588bea51ec7421152e15f5168b2aaf5502`; fetched master `fbac1d73b8645684850dfcc5ab2f6542a3e5758f`. Conflict-free merge tree `6b3eafe58f40f7bd110f5fd7377ddc294d9323bd`. Overlap reviewed: the upstream upload-test correction is already included, and CI artifact-list additions are independent. No unrelated rebase.
- **Environment:** Linux x86_64, GCC 15.2.0, AMD Threadripper 2950X; native release `-O3`. Independent ARM64/NEON kernel checks ran under QEMU, not full-game ARM execution.
- **Dependencies/configuration:** SDL3 prefix `/tmp/glob2-sdl3/prefix`; recording prefix `/tmp/glob2-terrain-baseline-build/recording/prefix`. Final tests use `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix/lib`, an isolated SDK copy with the repository PNG16 preservation patch. Original benchmark dependencies were hash-verified unchanged. Full provenance and SDK audit are in the bundle.
- **Coverage rationale:** Canonical terrain/persistence/experiments, weighted navigation and AI, ecology, scripting, projectile/health behavior, software/OpenGL rendering and authoring tools all changed. Independent reviews and direct algorithm oracles supplement engine integration, continuation and paired-game checks.
- **Build:** `GLOB2_SDL3_PREFIX=/tmp/glob2-sdl3/prefix GLOB2_RECORDING_PREFIX=/tmp/glob2-terrain-baseline-build/recording/prefix taskset -c 0-11 scons -j12 release=1 tests build/linux/client/release/src/glob2` — exit 0; logs `build-restored-final.log` and formatting-only `build-final-braces.log`.
- **Final unit command:** `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix/lib taskset -c 0-11 python3 test/run_tests.py --binary unit --no-display --artifacts artifacts/terrain-refactor/tests-restored-unit --junit artifacts/terrain-refactor/tests-restored-unit/junit.xml` — exit 0, 792 passed; 17 display cases omitted from this headless invocation and covered in earlier display runs.
- **Final focused command:** `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix/lib taskset -c 0-11 python3 test/run_tests.py --binary all --filter '*Gradient*/*' --filter 'Terrain*/*' --filter '*Continuation/*' --filter 'TurnEngineHarness/*' --filter 'Maxima.*/*' --filter 'JavaScript*/*' --filter 'MapQuery/*' --filter '*Save*/*' --filter 'MapTiling/*' --filter 'AIRules/*' -j8 --artifacts artifacts/terrain-refactor/tests-restored-final --junit artifacts/terrain-refactor/tests-restored-final/junit.xml` — exit 0, 290 groups / 425 individual cases, zero failures.
- **Additional results:** Serial/parallel JavaScript and legacy-save CLI/Maxima traces, six JavaScript saved continuations, shared-runtime continuation, software/OpenGL presentation, map CLI/images/reports and simulation golden/version checks passed. Independent sanitizer/scalar/SSE2/NEON oracles cover routing, projectile supercover and fertility math. Exact commands and logs are retained in the archive.
- **Performance/ecology:** 84 benchmark runs give median scenario CPU/tick change −8.80%, with a +18.89% outlier; changed AI/RNG work prevents a pure lookup-overhead claim. Generic paths and cold ecology rebuilds cost more. Training/holdout adequately sampled ecology gates passed; sparse cases remain inconclusive. All 96 paired AI games completed. The increased midgame starvation signal remains documented: targeted snapshots identify existing feeding/placement limitations, with no verified terrain-permission or routing defect.
- **Omissions/limits:** Full-game Windows/macOS/browser/ARM comparisons and human playtesting were not performed. Shared-host contention limits timing precision. No hosted engine-verification claim is made.
- **Maintainer acceptance:** The task's maintainer explicitly approved merging after the implementation, verification and remaining limitations were reported (“approved to merge this down”).

**Accessible evidence:** [evidence index](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67), [validation summary](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67/validation.md), [performance](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67/performance.md), [paired-game assessment](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67/ecology-assessment.md), [Cortex investigation](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67/cortex-findings.md), [Maxima investigation](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67/maxima-assessment.md), [17 MB evidence archive](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/raw/a33f4fb344cde64bf367ff82908483089ef3df67/terrain-validation-compact.tar.gz). The dedicated evidence branch is separate from product history and must not be merged.

The cheap build-contract failure finished as this PR merged. The introduced scene-header allowlist and terrain sprite-discovery gaps are repaired in #775. All 324 local build-system tests pass using the exact CI interpreter command (2 environment-dependent skips). Original failure and repair evidence: https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/ea4226abd173d30a749eec382f0b8ea362d29ac5/repair-validation.md
